metadata.title: Large-volume fractional isoperimetry on products of closed manifolds and Euclidean spaces
metadata.abstract: Let $M$ be a closed connected Riemannian manifold and let $\mathcal P_s$ be the fractional perimeter on $M\times\mathbb R^k$ defined through its heat semigroup, where $k\ge1$ and $0<s<1$. We prove that the straight cylinder $M\times B_R$, with $B_R\subset\mathbb R^k$ a ball of radius $R$, uniquely minimizes $\mathcal P_s$ among all measurable sets of the same volume, up to translations in $\mathbb R^k$ and null sets, whenever $R\sqrt{\lambda_1(M)}$ is at least an explicit threshold depending only on $k$ and $s$. Here $\lambda_1(M)$ is the first positive eigenvalue of the nonnegative Laplace--Beltrami operator $-\Delta_M$ on $M$. Under a larger threshold, the perimeter deficit controls both the deviation of the slice volumes from their mean and the square of the asymmetry relative to straight cylinders. For flat tori this gives large-volume uniqueness of straight cylinders for the periodic fractional perimeter, including singly periodic sets in every ambient dimension. The proof combines spectral reduction on $M$ with rearrangement of the Euclidean slices and a one-variable comparison between an interaction gain and a concavity loss.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 证明闭流形与欧氏空间乘积上，大体积分数周长的唯一极小者是直柱，并给出周长亏量的稳定性控制。
techniques: 热半群定义的分数周长
analysis.breakthrough: 将周期分数等周问题的大体积极小形状及稳定性归入统一判据。
analysis.limitations: 结论要求半径与流形首特征值满足显式阈值。
